content.title: Ohio State concludes practices with defense winning spring game
content.text: 1:48 pm ET April 18, 2026Brandon Inniss calls Julian Sayin a better leader this seasonDan AulbachInniss spoke to Big Ten Network on the sideline about Ohio State quarterback Julian Sayin flourishing into a bigger leadership role in 2026."Julian [Sayin] has definitely been a way better leader this year, in my opinion," Inniss said. "We're going to go out there to California in a couple of weeks and just get with Julian to keep up that connection, because that's the biggest thing for wide receivers, to have that quarterback-wide receiver connection. So we're going to have a great offseason."With Sayin starting, Inniss hauled in 26 catches for 271 yards last season.1:37 pm ET April 18, 2026Ohio State's Julian Sayin talks to BTN during gameAdam Jardy1:29 pm ET April 18, 2026Tavien St. Clair-led drive comes up shortAdam JardyWith the third quarter winding down and the Gray team ahead 30-17, Tavien St. Clair led the Scarlet team on a lengthy drive highlighted by a 38-yard pass up the right sideline to David Adolph.It didn't go much further. The offense failed to pick up a fourth-and-2 from the 15-yard line, again turning it over on downs as the defense now leads 35-17 at the end of the third quarter.1:20 pm ET April 18, 2026Second half underwayAdam JardyTavien St. Clair was under center to open the second half, but the defense forced a turnover on downs to push its lead to 30-17 in the third quarter.The game has switched to a running clock, with Justin Martin back in the game now at quarterback.1:16 pm ET April 18, 2026Ohio State announces spring game attendanceAdam JardyAccording to the university, an announced crowd of 40,240 has braved the elements for this year's spring game. It's slightly more than the 2025 crowd, which was announced at 40,136.1:01 pm ET April 18, 2026Missed field goal ends first halfAdam JardyQuarterback Luke Fahey's first drive of the game got the Scarlet team to within striking distance, but a 43-yard field goal attempt from Connor Hawkins went wide left with 28 seconds left.That gave Gray a 27-17 lead at the half, which was abruptly ended after the field goal attempt.12:56 pm ET April 18, 2026Defense gets another stopAdam JardyOn fourth and 2 from the 43-yard line, running back Ja'Kobi Jackson's attempted rush around the right end gained no ground and ended St. Clair's drive with a turnover on downs.Gray leads 27-17 now, and fans are heading for cover as the rain is picking up at Ohio Stadium with one minute left in the first half.12:53 pm ET April 18, 2026Defense extends leadAdam JardyJustyn Martin's first series showed off a strong arm but ended with a failed fourth-and-7 conversion from near midfield, leading to another punt.That gives Gray a 24-17 lead as Tavien St. Clair returns to the field with about 3:30 left in the first half.12:46 pm ET April 18, 2026Justyn Martin in at quarterbackAdam JardyJulian Sayin's day might already be over. With 6:33 left in the second quarter and the defense leading 23-17, last year's starter is on the sidelines and Maryland transfer Justyn Martin is under center for the Buckeyes.12:41 pm ET April 18, 2026Tavien St. Clair nearly picked off - twiceAdam JardyOhio State's defense nearly came up with two interceptions on the same drive, ultimately forcing a punt. First St. Clair's pass to the left sideline was nearly nabbed, then an attempt up the right sideline was batted down and nearly became a pick-six.The defense is within 17-16 after notching consecutive sacks on Julian Sayin with about eight minutes left in the second quarter.12:32 pm ET April 18, 2026Scarlet leads Gray after first quarterAdam JardyThe offense leads the defense 17-11 at the end of the first quarter, which was highlighted by a few nice throws from Tavien St. Clair, some scrambling from Julian Sayin and an interception by Beau Atkinson.12:28 pm ET April 18, 2026Tavien St. Clair finds Chris Henry Jr. for a touchdownAdam JardyA few plays after Julian Sayin was intercepted, sophomore Tavien St. Clair threw a 40-yard touchdown pass to Chris Henry in the left front corner of the end zone. It gave the Scarlet team a 17-5 lead with about two minutes left in the quarter.Henry beat Jordan Thomas down the sideline and created separation to haul in the pass.12:26 pm ET April 18, 2026Julian Sayin interceptedAdam JardyWith Scarlet ahead 10-2, quarterback Julian Sayin's pass as the pocket closed in around him was deflected at the line of scrimmage by Will Smith, batted into the air and hauled down by defensive end Beau Atkinson for a turnover.It pulled the Gray team within 10-5 with about three minutes left in the first quarter.12:16 pm ET April 18, 2026Julian Sayin scores first touchdown of spring gameBrianna Mac KayJulian Sayin recorded the first touchdown of the spring game, scoring on a 15-yard quarterback run to give the Scarlet team a 7-0 lead.Sayin finished the 2025 season with 3,610 passing yards for 32 touchdowns.12:12 pm ET April 18, 2026Jeremiah Smith got Ohio State spring game off to a most appropriate startLori SchmidtOn the first play from scrimmage for today's spring game, Buckeyes star receiver Jeremiah Smith made a 6-yard catch on a traditional swing play, then he was stopped when officials ruled him touched down. Ohio State is not live-tackling yet. Smith is coming off a 1,243-yard, 12-touchdown season. (He also had one rushing touchdown in 2025.)12:03 pm ET April 18, 2026Jaxon Smith-Njigba rings victory bellAdam JardyThe lower bowl of Ohio Stadium is maybe half full, with many fans aiming for B Deck seats and the cover they provide as rain looms in the area. The game will start under dry conditions, but we'll see how long that lasts.Former Ohio State wideout Jaxon Smith-Njigba just rang the pregame victory bell to get things underway.He told BTN he loved it because it's "old-school principle, new-school tradition."11:48 am ET April 18, 2026Ohio State spring game weather forecastLori SchmidtAccording to the National Weather Service, today's chance of rain peaks right around when OSU is scheduled to kick off its annual public scrimmage. There will be a 92% chance of precipitation in the noon hour. It will be about 74 degrees and wind gusts will reach up to 25 miles per hour.Today's stormy forecast already caused Cincinnati to scrap its plans to hold a spring showcase.11:40 am ET April 18, 2026What happened in OSU's 2025 spring game?Lori SchmidtThe 2025 spring game almost didn't happen.With the expanded playoff, Ohio State's championship win against Notre Dame fell on Jan. 20, much later than usual. Coach Ryan Day considered ending an abbreviated spring schedule with a "showcase" event instead of the usual scrimmage to spare his players even more wear and tear.In the end, he heard the many fans who called for a simulated game, and he decided the experience, especially for Ohio State's younger players, was worth it.The OSU offense came away with a 50-31 victory. Lincoln Kienholz was 12-18 for 158 yards and 2 TD. Julian Sayin was 17-24 for 175 and 1 TD. Tavien St. Clair's totals were 11 for 15 passing and 116 yards.11:34 am ET April 18, 2026Spring game uniformsJoey KaufmanWith the exception of a handful of College Football Playoff games over the past decade, the Buckeyes have not worn their “Heritage Stripe” uniforms since the mid-2000s, but they are in a variation of the look for the spring game.Their jerseys, including the non-contact ones for the quarterbacks, all have the gray sleeves.11:25 am ET April 18, 2026What was the attendance for the 2025 spring game?Lori SchmidtLast season, the announced crowd was 40,136 fans at Ohio Stadium. Given today's weather forecast, and the fact that there's no quarterback battle, as there was between Julian Sayin and Lincoln Kienholtz in 2025, that number is probably going to taper off a little bit.11:23 am ET April 18, 2026Offensive tackle injury updatesJoey KaufmanAustin Siereveld, the Buckeyes’ returning starting left tackle, is using crutches after he underwent a minor procedure that sidelined him for the rest of spring practice. Phillip Daniels, the returning right tackle, was also seen on crutches leaving a practice earlier this week, but was without them while watching warmups ahead of the spring game.Coach Ryan Day didn’t divulge details about the nature of their injuries, but said they are both expected to return this summer for workouts ahead of preseason training camp.
